name: Ai Devkit
description: A structured software development toolkit that helps Claude Code follow senior-engineer workflows. AI DevKit provides phase-based development lifecycle (requirements, design review, planning, implementation, testing, code review), persistent memory for cross-session knowledge, test-driven development, structured debugging, code simplification, and technical writing review. It ensures consistent engineering standards across your projects with reusable skills and configurable workflows.
longDescription:
Ships **24 skills**.

- **Skills** (24): `agent-communication` (AI DevKit · Exchange information with active Codex, Claude Code, and other AI agents using ai-devkit agent list,…), `agent-management` (AI DevKit · Manage running AI agents with ai-devkit agent commands), `agent-orchestration` (AI DevKit · Supervise multi-agent workflows over repeated passes: poll progress, unblock waiting agents, coordinate dependencies, relay outputs,…), `brainstorm` (AI DevKit · Use when the user asks to brainstorm, ideate, generate ideas, expand options, challenge ideas, pressure-test…), `changelog` (AI DevKit · Update CHANGELOG.md Unreleased items from git commits since the latest release), `dev-commit` (AI DevKit · Safe git commit workflow for AI coding agents), `dev-design` (AI DevKit · Design phase guidance for reviewing feature design against requirements), `dev-implementation` (AI DevKit · Implementation phase guidance for executing feature plans and checking implementation against design), and 16 more

Installs with `claude plugin install ai-devkit@claude-community` from `codeaholicguy/ai-devkit`.
